## Brief

The user wrote a first-draft lyric about repainting their childhood bedroom the weekend before the family house goes on the market, and asks for a second draft that scans and rhymes without losing the image of the old colour showing through the new one. Only the lyric-editor runs: no concept stage, the structure stage infers the form and meter from the draft, and the edited lyric must keep the phrase "the colour under the colour". The user asserts the draft is their own work.
